mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% in the month preceding the decision date predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 0.3 in the month before decision
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when CPIAUCSL crosses 0.3% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS employment figures above the prior quarter's average coincides with stronger S&P 500 20-day forward returns as labor market strength supports corporate optimism.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > Q1 average in current month
failure_condition: In 100+ test windows, no significant positive return when PAYEMS exceeds prior quarter average.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in GDPC1 quarterly demand (billions of chained USD) by at least 5% from the prior quarter is associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as investor caution about weak demand emerges.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous quarter by >=5% over the quarter ending before decision
failure_condition: Over 200 quarters, no significant negative 60-day returns when GDPC1 declines by >=5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (monthly index) below 100 triggers a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as market anticipates lower supply constraints and potential price support.
failure_condition: In 50 test windows, no positive 20-day returns when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month, the S&P 500 5-day forward return is expected to be negative due to immediate market reaction to higher rates.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous month + 0.25 in current month
failure_condition: Over 100 windows, no negative 5-day returns when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25pp.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS (demand in millions of dollars) exceeding 450,000 for two consecutive months indicates a strengthening demand environment, which predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 450000 for 2 consecutive months ending before decision
failure_condition: In 150 windows, no significant positive 60-day returns when RSAFS remains below 450,000 for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both HOUST (housing starts) and UNRATE (unemployment) by at least 1% and 0.2 percentage points respectively in the same month increases the probability of a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to dual recession signals offsetting each other.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < previous month by >=1% AND UNRATE < previous month by >=0.2pp in current month
failure_condition: In 80 interaction windows, no positive 20-day returns when both proxies decline as specified.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-crisis expansion regime (as defined by UNRATE < 4% and FEDFUNDS < 2%), a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return is more likely when UNRATE falls by at least 0.1 percentage points in the prior month.
candidate_trigger: Regime: UNRATE < 4% & FEDFUNDS < 2%; UNRATE < previous month - 0.1pp
failure_condition: In 100 regime windows, no significant positive 20-day returns when UNRATE declines by <0.1pp in expansion regime.
